_comment: Hand-authored verdicts for the 12.3.5→12.11.0 changelog audit (ticket 071), keyed by upstream PR number. `pkg`/`version`/`title` are embedded so this file is self-contained: xyflow/ is gitignored and does not survive a clean clone. This is a gate, not documentation: `npm run parity:changelog` fails if any in-range PR is missing here, or if a row breaks its bucket's rule. The rules and the bucket table live in `buckets.mjs`. Covered buckets (evidence required): docs, ts-only, surface, function, conformance, unit, system. Gap buckets (ticket or in-branch note required): gate-pending, ported-ungated, not-ported. Accepted (written reason required): accepted-ungated. Plus n/a, for changes with no PSFlow analogue. A gate-pending row also names `gate` — the covered bucket it will graduate into — and, where that gate is `system`, the corpus `scenario` that will drive it and the boundary `stage` it waits on; every other gate names a `test` instead. The scenario has to resolve against the corpus's name space, so a plan cannot be a name nobody wrote. `debt` marks the 57 rows tickets 076-079 filed as ported-and-ungated after the version sweep, and is what makes the corrected filing count derived rather than typed. `misfiled` marks a row whose claimed port was absent, wholly or in the changed branch. The flag stays after the port lands, because the filing was wrong either way.
